entries.name: Haiti earthquake remembrance
entries.capsule: Anniversary of the January 12, 2010 magnitude 7.0 earthquake near Léogâne, Haiti; for many families, the start of TPS.
entries.dateRule: January 12 each year (anniversary of the 2010 earthquake).
entries.whatItMarks: The 2010 earthquake in Haiti. Sahan Journal reports that many Haitians held Temporary Protected Status from shortly after it until TPS for Haiti ended in 2026.
entries.howCelebratedInMinnesota: No Minnesota remembrance event was found.

entries.name: Haitian Flag Day
entries.capsule: May 18 honors the blue and red Haitian flag, created in 1803 at Arcahaie, with music, dance and food.
entries.dateRule: May 18 each year; community events may fall on a nearby weekend.

Afoutayi announced it was moving to Toronto by summer 2026; no 2026 Minnesota event was found.

entries.howCelebratedInMinnesota: The Alliance Française Mpls/St Paul holds an annual celebration at 227 Colfax Ave. N., Minneapolis. In 2026 it ran Tuesday, July 14, 5 to 8 p.m., with live music, traditional French food, games, team competitions and family entertainment.

entries.name: Canadian Days (Little Canada)
entries.capsule: Little Canada's volunteer-run summer festival, held every year since 1977, celebrating the city's French Canadian founding.
entries.dateRule: Set each year by the volunteer Canadian Days committee; held in late July or early August.

dates.source: City of Little Canada (festival at Spooner Park, July 31, 2026)

entries.whatItMarks: The city's heritage as a French Canadian settlement founded by Benjamin Gervais in 1844.
entries.howCelebratedInMinnesota: Held every year since 1977 by volunteers. The 2026 festival, themed 'Where 50 Years Feels Like Home,' was at Spooner Park in Little Canada and opened July 31, 2026. The organizer's pages do not state the closing date.

entries.name: Mois de la Francophonie
entries.capsule: Each March the Alliance Française features one French-speaking country: Togo in 2024, Laos in 2025, Tunisia in 2026.
entries.dateRule: The month of March; program announced each year by the Alliance Française Mpls/St Paul.

dates.source: Alliance Française Mpls/St Paul (March 2026, celebrating Tunisia)

entries.whatItMarks: The diversity of the French-speaking world.
entries.howCelebratedInMinnesota: A month of cooking classes, art exhibits, talks, music and children's programs at the Alliance Française in Minneapolis. 2026 featured Tunisia, with a Tunisian tagine cooking class on March 3; 2024 featured Togo with the Twin Cities Togolese community.

entries.name: Cameroonian community soccer tournament
